rationale: The run landed on the homepage, which often shows no product tiles and may be blocked by a OneTrust cookie banner or a locale dialog. For robustness, we force a known PLP in the correct locale (en-gb), add safe consent/modal selectors, provide broader PLP container/tile fallbacks, and normalize URLs to avoid locale traps and the corporate monclergroup.com domain.
code_hints: After navigation, attempt cookie consent first: query #onetrust-accept-btn-handler and click if present; then close any dialog via div[role='dialog'] button[aria-label='Close'].
If still on homepage (no PLP container found within 5s), hard navigate to /en-gb/men/ready-to-wear/outerwear.
Wait for either plp.container_alt or at least 8 product_tile_alt anchors before extracting.
Scroll the PLP to the bottom twice with small delays to trigger lazy loading before counting product tiles.
Extract PDP URLs from the product tiles using hrefs; prefer absolute URLs or resolve against https://www.moncler.com.
On PDP, wait for price using existing selectors first; if missing, try price_alt: [data-testid='price'], [data-testid='pdp-price'], span[itemprop='price'], meta[itemprop='price'].
